description: Get or manage neural patterns Use when nothing native trains on your workflow — Claude Code has no learning loop. Use to train SONA/MoE/EWC patterns from successful task outcomes; query via neural_predict before spawning agents. Off-path for one-shot work.

alpha.description: Hybrid: cosine weight in [0,1]; (1-α) is BM25 weight (default 0.5, tuned ADR-082)

bodyWeight.description: Hybrid: multi-field BM25 weight for body/content (default 1.0)

ceWeight.description: Rerank: cross-encoder score weight in final combination (default 0.3, tuned ADR-083)

content.description: Pattern source text (used for BM25 in hybrid search; falls back to name)

hybridWeight.description: Rerank: hybrid score weight in final combination (default 0.7, tuned ADR-083)

mmrLambda.description: Hybrid: MMR balance — 1.0 = pure relevance, 0.0 = pure diversity (default 0.7, tuned ADR-082)

mode.description: Search mode — hybrid (cosine+BM25+MMR, default) or cosine (pre-3.10.18 behaviour, for A/B)

rerank.description: Hybrid: opt-in cross-encoder rerank pass over the top-K (ADR-080). Adds ~20-40 ms per (query, doc) pair; first call downloads ~30MB model. Gracefully degrades to hybrid+MMR order when unavailable.

subjectWeight.description: Hybrid: multi-field BM25 weight for subject/name (default 2.0 non-rerank, 3.0 with rerank — tuned ADR-082/083)

typePenaltyFactor.description: Hybrid: meta-commit score multiplier — release/merge/bump commits × this factor (default 1.0 = disabled; set 0.5 for aggressive suppression)

name: neural_patterns
